# BufferArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/BufferArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[Ark](../ark.md)

**Title:**
BufferArk

Specialized Ark contract for Fleet Buffer operations.

This contract holds a certain percentage of total assets in a buffer,
which are not deployed and not subject to yield-generating strategies.
The buffer ensures quick disembarkation of assets when needed.
Key features:
- Maintains a minimum buffer balance as per FleetCommander configuration
- Does not deploy assets to any yield-generating strategies
- Provides quick access to funds for disembarkation
(see {IFleetCommanderConfigProvider-config-minimumBufferBalance})


## Functions
### constructor

Initializes the BufferArk


```solidity
constructor(ArkParams memory _params, address commanderAddress) Ark(_params);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_params`|`ArkParams`|The ArkParams struct containing initialization parameters|
|`commanderAddress`|`address`|The address of the Fleet Commander|


### totalAssets

Returns the current underlying balance of the Ark

For BufferArk, total assets are simply the token balance of this contract,
as no assets are deployed to external strategies.


```solidity
function totalAssets() public view override returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The total assets in the Ark, in token precision|


### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Internal function to get the total assets that are withdrawable

For Buffer Ark, the total assets are always withdrawable


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal view override returns (uint256);
```

### _board

No-op for board function

This function is intentionally left empty because the BufferArk doesn't need to perform any
additional actions when boarding tokens. The actual token transfer is handled by the Ark.board() function,
and the BufferArk simply holds these tokens without deploying them to any strategy.


```solidity
function _board(uint256 amount, bytes calldata data) internal override;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens being boarded (unused in this implementation)|
|`data`|`bytes`|Additional data for boarding (unused in this implementation)|


### _disembark

No-op for disembark function

This function is intentionally left empty because the BufferArk doesn't need to perform any
additional actions when disembarking tokens. The actual token transfer is handled by the Ark.disembark()
function,
and the BufferArk simply releases these tokens without any complex withdrawal process.


```solidity
function _disembark(uint256 amount, bytes calldata data) internal override;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens being disembarked (unused in this implementation)|
|`data`|`bytes`|Additional data for disembarking (unused in this implementation)|


### _harvest

No-op for harvest function

This function is intentionally left empty and returns empty arrays because the BufferArk
does not generate any rewards. It's a simple holding contract for tokens, not an investment strategy.


```solidity
function _harvest(bytes calldata data)
    internal
    override
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint256[] memory rewardAmounts);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`data`|`bytes`|Additional data for harvesting (unused in this implementation)|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardTokens`|`address[]`|An empty array of reward token addresses|
|`rewardAmounts`|`uint256[]`|An empty array of reward amounts|
